caption:
🚀 Silkway Accelerator: Startaplar uchun onlayn infosessiya o‘tkaziladi

Astana Hub va Google for Startups hamkorligida Silkway Accelerator bo‘yicha onlayn infosessiya bo‘lib o‘tadi. Unda 7-batch uchun arizalar, dastur imkoniyatlari va startaplar uchun global o‘sish yo‘llari haqida ma’lumot beriladi.

Silkway Accelerator — mahsuloti bor, ilk foydalanuvchilari ishlatayotgan va masshtabga tayyor startaplarni xalqaro bozorga olib chiqishga qaratilgan akseleratsiya dasturi. Mentorlik, vorkshoplar, investorlar bilan uchrashuvlar va VC tarmoqlariga kirish imkoniyati mavjud.

📅 27-aprel | 16:00 (Toshkent vaqti)

Sessiyaga ro‘yxatdan o‘tish: https://forms.gle/HZW7vzbj8hFvrKde7

Silkway Accelerator 2026: https://astanahub.com/en/l/silkwayaccelerator2026

—

🚀 Silkway Accelerator: Online info session for startups

An online info session on the Silkway Accelerator will be held in partnership with Astana Hub and Google for Startups. The session will cover applications for the 7th batch, program opportunities, and pathways for startups to achieve global growth.

Silkway Accelerator is an international acceleration program designed for startups that already have a product, an initial user base, and are ready to scale globally. It offers mentorship, workshops, investor meetings, and access to VC networks.

📅 April 27 | 16:00 (Tashkent time)

Register for Session: https://forms.gle/HZW7vzbj8hFvrKde7

Silkway Accelerator 2026: https://astanahub.com/en/l/silkwayaccelerator2026
